# aware of not knowing

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:awareOfNotKnowing`](gmeow-awareOfNotKnowing.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/awareOfNotKnowing>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/metacognition`](../../slices/metacognition.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A known-unknown: an agent is aware that it does NOT know a subject — the second-order recognition of a gap in its own knowledge, the explicit boundary of what it knows. The reflexive complement of the cognition knowledge spectrum ([`gmeow:isAwareOf`](gmeow-isAwareOf.md) … [`gmeow:hasMastered`](gmeow-hasMastered.md)): where those record what an agent knows, this records a recognised edge of that knowledge. The RANGE is left intentionally open — the not-known may be a [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) or a [`gmeow:Proposition`](../classes/gmeow-Proposition.md) — and is documented in prose. NOT functional: an agent recognises many gaps at once.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) -> `?`

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:awareOfNotKnowing`](gmeow-awareOfNotKnowing.md) from [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) to `?` when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record the boundary of an agent's knowledge — a known-unknown the agent explicitly recognises — so a trustworthy memory can surface what it does not know and turn the gap into an inquiry.

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it for mere absence of a fact (a known-unknown is a RECOGNISED gap, second-order, not the open-world silence of an unasserted triple), avoid asserting an [rdfs:range](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#range) (the not-known surface stays open), and avoid minting a [`gmeow:motivates`](gmeow-motivates.md) partner; reuse [`gmeow:evokes`](gmeow-evokes.md) to raise the question.

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:awareOfNotKnowing`](gmeow-awareOfNotKnowing.md) from the agent to the not-known subject; to raise the inquiry, point [`gmeow:evokes`](gmeow-evokes.md) from that subject at a [`gmeow:Question`](../classes/gmeow-Question.md) and hold it open with [`gmeow:seeksToKnow`](gmeow-seeksToKnow.md) — reusing the inquiry slice rather than minting new terms.

### Scope notes

- Known-unknowns motivate inquiry by reference (documentation only — no new axiom): a recognised gap typically mints a [`gmeow:Question`](../classes/gmeow-Question.md), modelled by REUSING inquiry's open-domain [`gmeow:evokes`](gmeow-evokes.md) (the not-known subject evokes the question) and the inquiry spine ([`gmeow:seeksToKnow`](gmeow-seeksToKnow.md)), never by a new [`gmeow:motivates`](gmeow-motivates.md) property ([Principle 6](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-6)). The bridge to the inquiry slice is documented routing, not an entailment.
